title: ActivatedProjection
description: Bounded positive working view over one frozen semantic-space projection.

activated_identifier_assignments.description: Positive identifier-assignment records visible in the working view.

activated_objects.description: Positive object records visible in the current working view.

activated_occurrences.description: Positive authored-occurrence records visible in the working view.

activated_regions.description: Positive region records visible in the current working view.

activated_temporal_anchors.description: Positive temporal-anchor records visible in the working view.

activated_units.description: Positive unit records visible in the current working view.

configuration_snapshot_id.description: Configuration snapshot that bounded the view.

continuation_handles.description: Bounded continuation handles for inspectable omitted structure.

newest_utterance_id.description: Newest utterance identity used for activation.

problem_space_thread_id.description: Thread whose problem space shaped this view.

problem_space_version.description: Exact problem-space version used for activation.

projection_snapshot_id.description: Frozen projection snapshot from which the view was drawn.

ActivatedEdge.description:
Typed edge visible in an activated projection.

It mirrors represented projection structure and cannot invent a relation, execute traversal, or authorize semantic interpretation.

ActivatedIdentifierAssignmentRecord.description: Positive identifier-assignment visible in the working view.

activation_provenance.description: Reasons this assignment became visible in the working view.

available_surface_ids.description: Retrieval surfaces structurally capable of inspecting this assignment.

record_provenance.description: Corpus or materialization provenance from the frozen projection.

subject.description: Canonical projected subject of the assignment.

ActivatedObjectRecord.description:
Visible summary of one canonical semantic object.

It exposes identity and bounded structural previews only. It does not hydrate evidence, score relevance, or imply completeness.

activation_provenance.description: Provenance explaining why this object became visible.

available_surface_ids.description: Available surface identities visible for planning.

contained_region_count.description: Count of contained semantic regions in the full snapshot.

contained_unit_count.description: Count of contained semantic units in the full snapshot.

ActivatedOccurrenceRecord.description: Positive authored occurrence visible in the working view.

authored_target_text.description: Authored target text retained by the projection.

available_surface_ids.description: Retrieval surfaces structurally capable of inspecting this occurrence.

source.description: Authored object-field, semantic-region, or semantic-unit source.

source_span.description: Exact represented source span when present.

ActivatedRegionRecord.description:
Visible summary of one authored semantic region.

It preserves region identity and bounded contained-address previews but does not select units, collapse headings, or assert relevance.

visible_unit_ids.description: Bounded preview of directly contained canonical units.

ActivatedTemporalAnchorRecord.description: Positive temporal anchor visible in the working view.

available_surface_ids.description: Retrieval surfaces structurally capable of inspecting this anchor.

record_provenance.description: Corpus or materialization provenance from the projection.

subject.description: Canonical projected subject carrying the anchor.

ActivatedTextPreview.description:
Bounded activation-time visibility of one semantic unit's text.

Inline previews are planning material taken from represented normalized text. Unavailable content requires later typed hydration and is not read during activation.

oneOf.description: Bounded normalized text was available directly in the projection.

truncated.description: Whether represented normalized text continued beyond this preview.

oneOf.description:
The projection carries only a deterministic hydration address.

Activation does not dereference that address.

ActivatedUnitRecord.description:
Visible summary of one canonical semantic unit.

It exposes identity, bounded preview text, incidence summaries, anchors, and surfaces for planning. Full authored prose remains execution material; this record cannot admit or reject evidence.

text_preview.description: Activation-time text visibility without evidence hydration.

ActivationBand.description:
Current activation band assigned to a problem region.

A band changes visibility and foregrounding only. It does not duplicate the region or change its identity, applicability, lifecycle, or semantic strength. It is categorical and never a numeric attention or relevance score.

oneOf.description: Live adjacent structure that materially informs primary focus.
Lower-priority connected structure available for continuation.
Retained continuity outside the current foreground.

ActivationProvenance.description:
Source of positive activation for one visible record or edge.

Provenance explains navigation only. It is not a relevance, confidence, or truth score and cannot close an open tension.

oneOf.description: Exposed by one active problem region.

Exposed by one specific problem-space referent expression.

This records the textual source that caused exposure. It does not assert that the referent is canonically bound to the activated address.
Exposed by one active problem-space constraint.
Exposed by one explicit open tension.

Exposed by one preserved candidate of an open tension.

Candidate order is the declared vector order in the problem-space state. Exposure does not select this candidate or resolve the tension.

candidate_index.description: Zero-based candidate index within the preserved candidate vector.

oneOf.description: Exposed by one region's current attention band.

band.description: Current band in the shared attention lens.

oneOf.description: Exposed by a deterministic configuration default.
Exposed by a typed bounded expansion request.

AuthoredBlockType.description:
Authored block categories that may materialize one semantic unit.

The variants preserve source form and cannot split a canonical unit based on provider limits.

CandidateCount.description:
Exactness of a projection-access candidate count.

It preserves measurement status only and does not express confidence in semantic relevance.

oneOf.description: Deterministic estimate supplied by the surface.

ContinuationAccess.description:
Mechanism through which a continuation page is interpreted.

Projection-structure continuation follows frozen represented topology directly. Retrieval-surface continuation resumes one concrete projected surface. Neither variant executes continuation by itself.

oneOf.description: Continue deterministic structure represented directly by the projection.
Continue one concrete projected retrieval surface.

surface_kind.description: Stable surface family declared by the projection.

ContinuationFilter.description: Typed filter applied to a continuation handle.

oneOf.description: Restrict to one projected structural transition.
Restrict source objects to a canonical path prefix.
Restrict to one projected semantic-object class.
Restrict by one projected identifier and optional represented value.

ContinuationHandle.description: Bounded continuation descriptor for a high-degree or truncated view.

access.description: Mechanism required to interpret and continue this handle.

activation_provenance.description: Reasons the truncated neighbourhood or result set became visible.

configuration_snapshot_id.description: Activation configuration snapshot required by this continuation.

filters.description: Typed filters already applied to the continuation.

newest_utterance_id.description: Newest utterance identity used for the original activation.

next_offset.description: Zero-based next offset in that stable ordering.

next_page_limit.description: Maximum records permitted in the next page.

ordering.description: Stable ordering under which the cursor is interpreted.

problem_space_thread_id.description: Thread whose accepted problem space shaped the original activation.

problem_space_version.description: Exact accepted problem-space version used for the original activation.

projection_snapshot_id.description: Frozen projection snapshot required by this continuation.

ContinuationOrdering.description: Stable ordering under which a continuation cursor is interpreted.

oneOf.description: Stable order of the corresponding frozen projection vector.
Stable order declared by one deterministic surface.

ContinuationOrigin.description: Original probe or structural neighbourhood described by a continuation handle.

oneOf.description: Continuation of one deterministic textual surface probe.
Continuation of one temporal surface probe.

CountByLabel.description:
Count associated with one represented label.

This is mechanical telemetry, not a relevance distribution.

label.description: Identifier, object class, or other projected label.

Direction.description:
Explicit direction for a represented structural connection.

Direction authorizes no traversal by itself; it is valid only when the projection represents the requested incidence.

oneOf.description: Move from source incidence toward its represented target.
Move from a target toward represented incoming incidence.

IdentifierAddress.description:
Address of an identifier descriptor or assignment.

It represents a named projected surface and optional represented value. It cannot replace canonical object or unit identity.

identifier_name.description: Identifier name represented by the projection.

represented_value.description: Optional exact represented value used to address one assignment.

IdentifierValue.description:
Value carried by one identifier assignment.

This is a closed structural union for exchange. It cannot be interpreted as evidence or a relation without its descriptor and provenance.

oneOf.description: Authored field is present with a null value.

OccurrencePresentation.description:
Presentation form of an authored occurrence.

Presentation does not create a second target object or change canonical identity.

OccurrenceSource.description:
Authored source surface of one occurrence.

It distinguishes object-field, semantic-region marker, and semantic-unit body contexts and cannot transfer identifiers between source and target.

oneOf.description: Occurrence authored in an object field.
Occurrence authored in a canonical semantic-region marker, such as a heading containing a link without any unit-worthy authored block.
Occurrence authored in a semantic unit body.

ProjectionTelemetry.description:
Measured access telemetry for an activated surface or region.

It reports counts, depth, truncation, budget, and continuation. It is not a semantic score and has no evidence-admission authority.

identifier_type_distribution.description: Bounded counts by represented identifier or type label.

match_mode.description: Exact projected surface match mode used by the probe.

probe_id.description: Stable identity of the exact activation probe being measured.

returned_count.description: Count returned into the visible view.

surface_kind.description: Retrieval surface family measured by this record.

telemetry_id.description: Stable identity of this telemetry record.

unresolved_target_count.description: Count of structurally unresolved authored targets.

RecordProvenance.description:
Provenance of a projected or retrieved fact.

It records where a fact was materialized from. It may not upgrade source authority or turn contextual participation into intrinsic typing.

oneOf.description: Frontmatter field on a canonical source object.

object_id.description: Canonical object that owns the field.

oneOf.description: Authored body span inside a canonical semantic unit.

unit_id.description: Canonical semantic unit containing the source.

rule.description: Named materialization rule or contract source.

sources.description: Source record addresses used by the rule.

RetrievalSurfaceAddress.description:
Address of a retrieval-surface descriptor.

It names a projected capability only. It does not execute the surface or imply that the surface is available for a particular address.

RetrievalSurfaceKind.description:
Retrieval-surface families admitted by the contracts.

A family describes a capability class only; the projection determines whether a concrete surface exists and what it may inspect.

SemanticAddress.description:
Canonical or projected address used by plans and provenance records.

It can point only to represented address categories. It does not prove that the target exists in a given snapshot; structural conformance owns that later check.

SemanticRegionAddress.description:
Address of an authored structural region inside one semantic object.

The address preserves both the canonical parent object and a non-empty authored structural address. It has no authority to select a unit, infer a heading target, or treat the region as a separate epistemic object class.

authored_structural_address.description: Non-empty authored heading, block, or structural address.

SourceSpan.description:
Authored or materialized source span.

This is provenance for a represented record. It cannot reinterpret the source or establish semantic relevance.

end_byte.description: Exclusive ending byte offset when known.

source.description: Source path or stable source identity.

start_byte.description: Inclusive starting byte offset when known.

SurfaceMatchMode.description:
Query or match modes exposed by a retrieval surface.

Modes constrain execution shape only and do not imply semantic relevance.

oneOf.description: Named configured mode not hard-coded as corpus meaning.

TemporalValue.description:
Structured temporal value represented by a temporal anchor.

It preserves authored precision and does not perform ordering or inference.

oneOf.description: Calendar date in ISO-like authored form.
Date and time with an explicit offset or zone in authored form.
Named temporal label when no stronger syntax is admitted.

TruncationState.description:
Mechanical truncation state of an activated result set.

It describes bounded visibility only and authorizes no conclusion about omitted corpus material.

oneOf.description: No truncation occurred within the measured scope.
Configured view bound truncated the visible result.
Hard expansion budget truncated the visible result.
